responsibility: Implements the High-GIMPLE to Low-GIMPLE lowering pass. Its job is to erase lexical-scope bind structure from executable code, canonicalize and merge returns into a single exit path, lower exception-related constructs and special builtins such as __builtin_setjmp and posix_memalign into explicit low-level control flow and helper calls, and record local declarations, producing the simpler statement/control-flow form expected by CFG construction and later SSA passes.
same_name_distinction: Implements the actual High-GIMPLE to Low-GIMPLE lowering pass, including transformation of binds, returns, exception-related constructs, and special builtins like __builtin_setjmp and posix_memalign, whereas gcc/gimple-low.h only exposes helper queries and variable-recording declarations related to lowering.
